pilots.title: AI業務効率化｜要点と実務上の注意点
pilots.visual_motif: A left-to-right workflow of rounded tool blocks that splits into two lanes: one lane marked by a small spark/gear (work handed to AI), the other ending in a checkmark (a person confirms). Flat vector, no product logos.

tone.nuance: calm teal on light grey; practical and orderly, the 'entry point' of the category

pilots.list_intent: The category's general entry: reads as 'how to start using AI for work', calmer than the product-specific cards next to it.
notes: The article frames AI's job as two distinct roles; the two-lane split mirrors that without claiming specifics.
Do not draw Make or ChatGPT logos even though the article uses them as examples.

pilots.title: ChatGPT法人プラン｜プラン別の料金と選び方
pilots.visual_motif: Three plan cards of increasing height laid out side by side in a horizontal row (a comparison composition), each with a row of small seat (person) icons; no prices, currencies or plan names.

tone.family: ChatGPT の法人利用 (料金・プラン)
tone.nuance: clear blue; structured and comparative, like a clean pricing table without numbers

pilots.list_intent: Instantly reads as 'compare the business plans'; must be distinguishable from the adjacent ChatGPT Enterprise card by motif (cards and seats vs. admin panel).
notes: The article is seat-based (シート appears 23 times), so seat icons carry the theme.
Never print amounts or dates: the article's prices are 'as of 2026-09' and would go stale in an image.
'ChatGPT' may appear as a small sub label in plain type only; no OpenAI mark.

distinguish_from.rule: emphasise comparison: horizontal row of parallel cards, bright blue

pilots.title: AIエージェント｜意味・種類・選び方の基礎知識
pilots.visual_motif: A central rounded node linked by thin lines to four small icons (calendar, document, data table, message), suggesting an agent that acts across tasks; concept-map style.

tone.family: AI エージェント・生成 AI
tone.nuance: indigo; slightly more conceptual than the others, still flat and quiet

pilots.list_intent: Reads as 'what is an AI agent' (a definition/entry article), not a product review.
notes: Two lines 'AIエージェント' / 'とは' at 96px; line 1 measures 670px, so the text column is widened to 690px and the motif moves right (x >= 780).
Avoid robot/humanoid clichés and sci-fi visuals; the article stresses that the term means different things per product.

pilots.title: ChatGPT Enterprise｜要点と実務上の注意点
pilots.visual_motif: One organization admin panel (toggle switches and a user list) guarded by a small shield and a lock on a data stack, plus a short checklist; a compact, vertically grouped composition that conveys management and security.

tone.family: ChatGPT の法人利用 (導入・管理)
tone.nuance: deeper slate blue with a blue highlight; more 'governed/enterprise' than the plan-comparison card

pilots.list_intent: Must differ at a glance from the ChatGPT法人プラン card beside it: admin/data motif and darker slate tone vs. plan cards and bright blue.
notes: The article centres on data (16 mentions), administration and SSO, and on pricing by inquiry; the admin-panel + lock motif reflects that without inventing features.
Two lines 'Enterprise' / 'の要点' at 100px (line 1 measures 517px); one line would be 785px even at 96px.
No OpenAI logo, no imitation of the real ChatGPT UI.

distinguish_from.rule: emphasise management/security: single guarded panel, deep slate blue
